messages:
marie: kicking off a config-only deploy for a 'tiny-slot' routing tweak + batch floor. change window 22:00-23:00 PT. canary 5% for 15m. release tag config-2026-03-tiny-slot

deploy-bot: started canary for config-2026-03-tiny-slot (5% traffic). canary id: cb-9182. will post metrics after 5m and 15m.

sam: thanks — i'll watch latency and p50/p95 traces. i'll also keep an eye on cold-starts and kv cache miss rate.

rahul: quick q: what is the explicit fallback if we see kv-cache pressure? also what's the batch_window change?

marie: fallback is routing->previous-policy (config rollback path) + auto-shrink batch_window to 20ms and batch_size_floor to 1 for affected tenants. batch_window is currently 40ms -> 30ms in this config, batch_floor 2 -> 3 (we're raising min batch_size to reduce tiny-batch churn).

jordan: adding a short release note to the internal changelog: "tiny-slot routing: raise min batch, tighten window to reduce oscillation; fallback to previous routing policy on kv pressure." will push to /releases/briefs.

sam: smoke test commands I'm going to run after canary stabilizes:
```
# sanity qps run
python tools/loadtest.py --target tenant-sim --qps 300 --duration 120
# tail-latency view
./scripts/trace_tail.sh cb-9182
```

rahul: ran a dry-run locally against staging traffic mix — saw a 3.8% tail increase at synthetic peak. noting it here so we don't get surprised.

marie: good catch. let's proceed but keep rollback hot. rollback command (if needed):
```
deploy-bot rollback-canary cb-9182 --reason "tail-latency-regression"
```

sam: if we need to pin routing version for specific tenants, use this command:
```
redeployctl pin-routing --tenant-id <TENANT> --config config-2026-02-routing --until 2026-03-30
```
I'll prepare a list of high-QPS tenants to pin preemptively if metrics spike.

jordan: FYI ops oncall is looped in. @deploy-bot please trigger the canary-health alert at +5m and +15m.

deploy-bot: scheduled health-checks for cb-9182 at +5m and +15m. will post summary.

sam: observational checklist for the canary: p50/p95/p99, kvcache_hit_ratio, request-retry-rate, tenant-error-rate, token-cost delta. if any exceed thresholds, call rollback. thresholds posted in #eng-releases-playbook.

marie: agreed. decision criteria: p99 up > 7% or kvcache_hit_ratio down > 5% or tenant-error-rate up > 0.5% -> rollback. otherwise continue to staged roll at 40% after 30m.

rahul: logging note: I'm adding an extra debug flag for 5m to collect more kv cache metrics (will auto-turn-off). minimal perf impact expected.

deploy-bot: 5m check complete for cb-9182: p50 +1.2%, p95 +2.9%, p99 +5.1%, kvcache_hit_ratio -0.8%. no thresholds breached. next check at +15m.

sam: looks healthy so far. continuing to monitor. i'll post if anything trends. :thumbsup:

marie: thanks team. if +15m looks good we'll schedule the 40% ramp at 23:00 and run post-roll validation. leaving this thread open for rollback callouts.
